purpose: Staging pin collection for the XMX 4.1.2 DLL. This file is NOT profiles/registry.json and MUST NOT be consumed by tools/pre_profile_registry.py. It records every hash already fixed for 4.1.2 and marks everything still unknown as REQUIRED-TBD so a future registry entry can be built without inventing values. Promotion to the registry is blocked until all REQUIRED-TBD fields resolve (see docs/shim-bridge.md).

loader.flow: index clamp (i>5 -> 0); FindResourceW/LoadResource/LockResource on RCDATA id by index; Cabinet.dll ordinals 40/43/45 (LZMS, algorithm 5, 64 KiB blocks); exact-size match; one-shot BCryptHash SHA-256 (0x41) over decompressed bytes vs compiled-in hex digest
